# pangolin_custom_dns_record (Resource)

An extra DNS record served by Pangolin's nameservers on a domain delegated to Pangolin DNS (an `ns` domain used by this organization alone). Requires Pangolin 1.26 or later with an Enterprise license. Import using the format `<org_id>:<domain_id>:<custom_dns_record_id>`, e.g. `terraform import pangolin_custom_dns_record.example acme:d1:3`. After an import, write `name` and `values` the way Pangolin stores them (lowercase, relative name, no trailing dots) or expect one in-place update that settles the difference.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Mail for a domain delegated to Pangolin DNS (Pangolin 1.26+, Enterprise).
resource "pangolin_custom_dns_record" "mx" {
  org_id    = pangolin_organization.example.org_id
  domain_id = pangolin_domain.example.domain_id
  name      = "@"
  type      = "MX"
  values    = ["mx1.mail.example.net", "mx2.mail.example.net"]
  priority  = 10
}

resource "pangolin_custom_dns_record" "spf" {
  org_id    = pangolin_organization.example.org_id
  domain_id = pangolin_domain.example.domain_id
  name      = "@"
  type      = "TXT"
  values    = ["v=spf1 include:mail.example.net -all"]
  ttl       = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) Delegated domain the record is served under.
- `name` (String) Record name relative to the domain, e.g. `www`, `_dmarc` or `*.apps`. Use `@` for the domain itself. A fully qualified name within the domain is also accepted.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the domain belongs to.
- `type` (String) One of A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, SRV, TXT.
- `values` (List of String) Record data, one entry per resource record (e.g. both nameservers of an NS record). At most 10. CNAME records take exactly one. Hostnames for CNAME, NS, MX and SRV must be fully qualified.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the record is served. Defaults to true.
- `port` (Number) Port. Required for SRV records, and not valid for any other type.
- `priority` (Number) Priority. Required for MX and SRV records, and not valid for any other type.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds, from 60 to 86400. Defaults to 300.
- `weight` (Number) Weight. Required for SRV records, and not valid for any other type.

### Read-Only

- `custom_dns_record_id` (Number) Pangolin-assigned record ID.
- `full_domain` (String) Fully qualified name the record is served at.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pangolin_custom_dns_record.mx acme:d1:3
```
